fullContentHtml:
Haryana HTET Revised Result 2026 – Full Details

Board of School Education (BSEH), Haryana has recently released the revised result for the PRT, TGT, PGT Test on the official website of BSEH. Online applying process for Haryana HTET Online Form 2026 were accepted from 24 December 2025 to 05 January 2026. The examination was conducted on 04 & 05 July 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can can download their Haryana HTET Revised Result 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 24 December 2025
  • Application Start Date : 24 December 2025
  • Last Date : 05 January 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 05 January 2026
  • Correction Form : Notify Later
  • Exam Date : 04-05 July 2026
  • Exam City Details : 25 June 2026
  • Admit Card : 30 June 2026
  • Answer Key : 06 July 2026
  • Final Answer Key : 05 August 2026
  • Result : 05 August 2026
  • Score Card / Certificate : 22 August 2026
  • Revised Result : 30 September 2026

Application Fee

  • For Level One
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 1000/-
  • Other State (Including SC & PH) : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, PH Candidates of Haryana : Rs. 500/-
  • For Level Two
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 1800/-
  • Other State (Including SC & PH) : Rs. 1800/-
  • SC, PH Candidates of Haryana : Rs. 900/-
  • For Level Three
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 2400/-
  • Other State (Including SC & PH) : Rs. 2400/-
  • SC, PH Candidates of Haryana : Rs. 1200/-
  • Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, E Challan

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

Haryana HTET Revised Result 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.
